instruction: Make Qwant the default search engine for all my searches in the browser.

metadata.explanation: Variation 7: Change default search engine to Qwant. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator verifies search engine is set to 'Qwant'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_default_search_engine reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts the default search engine short_name
Metric logic is correct: match_in_list checks if the result matches the expected value 'Qwant'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'Qwant' is the search engine the user should set as default
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction (default search engine = Qwant)
Postconfig is appropriate: Restarting Chrome ensures settings are persisted to disk and can be verified
Data flow is correct: User changes setting → Chrome writes to Preferences → Postconfig restarts Chrome → Getter reads Preferences → Metric verifies
